items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Nancy Wilson did a record where there was a tune on there called “It’s All Over Mr. Walker I Don’t Want the New York Secretary’s Life.”

ctx.x: Yeah and she took heat for it too she told me.

I’m sure she did. Cannonball must have taken heat for “Mercy, Mercy, Mercy” and all that stuff. I mean I don’t know the record business you know. I don’t know how these characters operate at the desk you know, but these guys they get an advance and then they’ve got to sell records. And Cannonball started doing all that pop music and Nancy © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
Wilson did a record where there was a tune on there called “It’s All Over Mr. Walker I Don’t Want the New York Secretary’s Life.” A country & western tune.
